review.shorterRoute: Reuse the native Laurent Frobenius identity, actual decomposition residue automorphism, native finite-coordinate exchange and Mathlib coe_inclusion. Inverse coefficient action followed by the absolute pth power gives the actual constant-linear q-substitution on the original residue image. The explicit monic polynomial proves integrality; the native finite-coordinate theorem proves finiteness. The second original residue Hecke map is the first map after this Frobenius. Named Mathlib inclusion evaluation avoids kernel normalization of the concrete intermediate-field record without increasing limits.
assumptionsToDischarge: For a decomposition element whose action on residue constants is pth power, the original residue image has a constant-linear geometric Frobenius with literal q to q^p Laurent action.
The actual endomorphism is integral, and finite for a finite-index original subgroup containing T.
The actual Gamma1 residue Hecke beta map factors through this endomorphism and the actual alpha inclusion.
review.remaining: The arithmetic Frobenius constant-action premise is explicit.
